name: audit_site
description: Audits every page linked from an index page of a local site and writes audit.json (status, title, h1Count, brokenLinks per page). Returns a short summary.
whenToUse: When asked to (re-)audit the local site's pages; replaces ad-hoc curl loops.

output.description: Output path relative to project dir (default audit.json)

provenance.reason: audit 30 pages now and re-audit after future deploys
